title: Sage Agastya's advice
introduction: Sage Agastya advises Rama to recites the 'Aditya Hridaya', a collection of verses in praise of the sun-god, with a view to gaining victory.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 105th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् |
रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्
दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम् |
उपगम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवान् ऋषिः
verses.iast:
tato yuddhapariśrāntaṃ samare cintayā sthitam |
rāvaṇaṃ cāgrato dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya samupasthitam
daivataiśca samāgamya draṣṭumabhyāgato raṇam |
upagamyābravīdrāmamagastyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Approaching Rama standing absorbed in fight in the battle-field, exhausted as he was by the fight, and seeing Ravana who came nearby, facing him duly prepared for the battle, the glorious sage, Agastya, who had come together with the gods, to perceive the battle, then spoke as foolows:

glosses.meaning: exhausted as he was by the fight

verses.devanagari:
राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम् |
येन सर्वानरीन्वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसे
verses.iast:
rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṃ sanātanam |
yena sarvānarīnvatsa samare vijayiṣyase
verses.translation: "O Rama, the mighty armed! Hear the following eternal secret, by which you can conquer all the enemies in battle, my child!"

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् |
जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम्
सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् |
चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
ādityahṛdayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam |
jayāvahaṃ japennityamakṣayyaṃ paramaṃ śivam
sarvamaṇ^galamaṇ^galyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam

glosses.meaning: 'Aditya Hridaya' (which is intended to propitiate Brahma
which can destroy all the adversaries

verses.devanagari:
रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम् |
पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम्
verses.iast:
raśmimantaṃ samudyantaṃ devāsuranamaskṛtam |
pūjayasva vivasvantaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram
verses.translation: "Worship the sun-god, the ruler of the worlds, who is crowned with the rays, who appears at the horizon, who is greeted by the gods and the demons alike, shines forth; covering up all other lights and brings light to the world."

glosses.meaning: who is crowned with the rays
who is greeted by the gods and the demons alike
shining forth covering all other lights
and brings light to the world.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः |
एष देवासुरगणान् लोकान् पाति गभस्तिभिः
verses.iast:
sarvadevātmako hyeṣa tejasvī raśmibhāvanaḥ |
eṣa devāsuragaṇān lokān pāti gabhastibhiḥ
verses.translation: "He is the embodiment of all gods, full of glory and the reflector of rays. He protects the multitude of gods and demons as well as their worlds by his rays."

glosses.meaning: the multitude of gods and demons

verses.devanagari:
एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः |
महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपांपतिः
verses.iast:
eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaḥ skandaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
mahendro dhanadaḥ kālo yamaḥ somo hyapāmpatiḥ
verses.translation: "He is Brahma the creator, Vishnu the protector of the Universe, Lord Shiva the god of destruction, Skanda (son of Lord Shiva), Prajapati (the ten lords of creted beings), Indra the ruler of gods, Kubera the bestower of riches, Kala the Time-spirit, Yama the god of retribution, Soma the moon-god and Varuna the ruler of the waters."

glosses.meaning: Lord Shiva the god of destruction
Prajapati (the ten lords of created beings viz. Marichi

verses.devanagari:
पितरो वसवः साध्या अश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः |
वायुर्वह्निः प्रजाः प्राण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः
verses.iast:
pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā aśvinau maruto manuḥ |
vāyurvahniḥ prajāḥ prāṇa ṛtukartā prabhākaraḥ
verses.translation: "The Pitrus (manes), the eight Vasus, the twelve Sadhyas, the two Ashvins the physicians of gods, the fortymine Maruts (wind-gods), Manu (a progenitor of the human race), Vayu the wind-god, the fire-god, the created beings, the life-breath of the universe, the source of teh seasons and the store-house of light."

glosses.meaning: the two Ashvins = the physicians of gods
Manu ( a progenitor of the human race)

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान् |
सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः
verses.iast:
ādityaḥ savitā sūryaḥ khagaḥ pūṣā gabhastimān |
suvarṇasadṛśo bhānurhiraṇyaretā divākaraḥ
verses.translation: "An off-spring of Aditi, the progenitor of all, Surya the sun-god and the provocator of acts in people, the courser in the sky, the nourisher of all iwth rain, the possessor of rays the golden, the brilliant, having golden seed whose energy constitutes the seed of the universe and the maker of the day."

glosses.meaning: the nourisher of all with rain
and the maker of the day.

verses.devanagari:
हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिर्मरीचिमान् |
तिमिरोन्मधनः शम्भुस्त्वष्टा मार्तण्डकोऽंशुमान्
verses.iast:
haridaśvaḥ sahasrārciḥ saptasaptirmarīcimān |
timironmadhanaḥ śambhustvaṣṭā mārtaṇḍako'ṃśumān
verses.translation: "He has seven green horses, is thousand-rayed, full of rays, the destroyer of darkness, the source of happiness, maker of thinness, the infuser of life in the lifeless cosmic egg and radiant."

glosses.meaning: the infuser of life in the lifeless cosmic egg

verses.devanagari:
हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनोऽहस्करो रविः |
अग्निगर्भोऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः
verses.iast:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śiśirastapano'haskaro raviḥ |
agnigarbho'diteḥ putraḥ śaṇ^khaḥ śiśiranāśanaḥ
verses.translation: "He is a golden foetus, maker of coolness, creator of heat, the bringer of a day, the one who is eulogized by all, pregnant with fire, the son of Aditi, the one who pacifies himself in the evening and the destroyer of frost."

glosses.meaning: the one who is eulogized by all
the one who pacifies himself in the evening

verses.devanagari:
व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी बुग्यजुः सामपारगः |
घनवृष्टिरपां मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवंगमः
verses.iast:
vyomanāthastamobhedī bugyajuḥ sāmapāragaḥ |
ghanavṛṣṭirapāṃ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: "He is the lord of the sky, the disperser of darkness, the master of the three Vedas (Viz. Rik, Sama and Yajur), the sender of thick rain, the friend of water and the on who courses swiftly in the path of the sky."

glosses.meaning: (He is) the lord of the sky
the master of the three Vedas (Rik
and the one who courses swiftly in the path of the sky.

verses.devanagari:
आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः |
कविर्विश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः
verses.iast:
ātapī maṇḍalī mṛtyuḥ piṇ^galaḥ sarvatāpanaḥ |
kavirviśvo mahātejā raktaḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: "He is the radiator of heat and adrned with a circle of rays. He is death himself, tawny of hue, a giver of warmth to all, omniscent, all-formed, endowed with extra-ordinary splendour, the one who has an affection in all and the source of all evolutes."

glosses.meaning: and adorned with a circle of rays
the one who has an affection in all
and the source of all evolutes.

verses.devanagari:
नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः |
तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन्नमो.स्तु ते
verses.iast:
nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmadhipo viśvabhāvanaḥ |
tejasāmapi tejasvī dvādaśātmannamo.stu te
verses.translation: "He is the controller of all lunar mansions, planets and stars, the creator of all and the resplendent among the splendid. O god, appearing in twelve forms (in the shape of twelve months in a year), hail to you."

glosses.meaning: the controller of all lunar mansions

verses.devanagari:
नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमायाद्रये नमः |
ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः
verses.iast:
namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścimāyādraye namaḥ |
jyotirgaṇānāṃ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ
verses.translation: "Hail to you in the form of eastern mountain and hail to the western mountain. Hail to the lord of host of luminaries and hail to the lord of the day."

glosses.meaning: in the form of eastern mountain namaH = and hail
to the lord of hosts of luminaries
to the lord of the day.

verses.devanagari:
जयाय जयभद्राय हर्याश्वाय नमो नमः |
नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः
verses.iast:
jayāya jayabhadrāya haryāśvāya namo namaḥ |
namo namaḥ sahasrāṃśo ādityāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: "Hail to you, the giver of victory, hail to you, the joy born of victory! Hail to you, the god with green horses, hail to you, having thousands of rays! Hail, hail to you the son of Aditi!

verses.devanagari:
नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः |
नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय प्रचण्डाय नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.iast:
nama ugrāya vīrāya sāraṇ^gāya namo namaḥ |
namaḥ padmaprabodhāya pracaṇḍāya namo'stu te
verses.translation: "Hail to you, the fierce one, hail to you the valiant one! Hail to you, the one with variegated colours! Hail to you, the awakener of the louts, hail to you, the furious one!"

glosses.meaning: hail to you the furious one!

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे |
भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः
verses.iast:
brahmeśānācyuteśāya sūryāyādityavarcase |
bhāsvate sarvabhakṣāya raudrāya vapuṣe namaḥ
verses.translation: "Hail to you, the ruler of Brahma, Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu the infallible, the sun-god, the light indwelling the solar orb, the resplendent one, the devourer of all, appearing in form of Rudra."

glosses.meaning: the light indwelling the solar orb
appearing in teh form of Rudra.

verses.devanagari:
तमोघ्नाय हिमग्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने |
कृतघ्नघ्नाय देवाय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः
verses.iast:
tamoghnāya himagnāya śatrughnāyāmitātmane |
kṛtaghnaghnāya devāya jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: "Hail to you, the dispeller of darkness, the destroyer of cold, the exterminator of foes, the one whose extent in immeasurable, the destroyer of the ungrateful, the god, who is the ruler of all lights."

glosses.meaning: the one whose extent is immeasurable
who is the ruler of all lights.

verses.devanagari:
तप्तचामीकराभाय हरये विश्वकर्मणे |
नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे
verses.iast:
taptacāmīkarābhāya haraye viśvakarmaṇe |
namastamobhinighnāya rucaye lokasākṣiṇe
verses.translation: "Hail to you, possessing the lustre of refined gold, the dispeller of ignorance, the architect of the universe, the uprooter of darkness, the splendour incarnate, the onlooker of the world!'"

glosses.meaning: possessing the lustre of refined gold

verses.devanagari:
नाशयत्येष वै भूतं तदेव सृजति प्रभुः |
पायत्येष तपत्येष वर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः
verses.iast:
nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṃ tadeva sṛjati prabhuḥ |
pāyatyeṣa tapatyeṣa varṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ
verses.translation: "This sun, the lord alone destroys and brings into existence all the brings. He radiates heat by his rays. He sends the rain."

verses.devanagari:
एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः |
एष चैवाग्निहोत्रं च फलं चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम्
verses.iast:
eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ |
eṣa caivāgnihotraṃ ca phalaṃ caivāgnihotriṇām
verses.translation: "Planted in all created beings, he remains awake, when they have fallen asleep. He alone is the oblation to the fire-god and the fruit attained by those who pour such oblations."

glosses.meaning: is the oblation to the fire-god
attained by those who pour such oblations.

verses.devanagari:
देवाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च |
यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्वेषु परमप्रभुः
verses.iast:
devāśca kratavaścaiva kratūnāṃ phalameva ca |
yāni kṛtyāni lokeṣu sarveṣu paramaprabhuḥ
verses.translation: "He comprises all the gods, as well as the sacrifies as also the fruit of all sacrifices. He is a supremely competent one of all activities, which are found in all the worlds."

glosses.meaning: as also the fruit of sacrifices
he is the supremely competent one

verses.devanagari:
एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च |
कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव
verses.iast:
enamāpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca |
kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścinnāvasīdati rāghava
verses.translation: "O Rama! No individual glorifying this sun-god, in distresses in difficulties; in the woods or in times of peril, comes to grief."

verses.devanagari:
पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम् |
एतत्त्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यसि
verses.iast:
pūjayasvainamekāgro devadevaṃ jagatpatim |
etattriguṇitaṃ japtvā yuddheṣu vijayiṣyasi
verses.translation: "Worship this sun-god, the lord of the universe and the god of all gods with undivided attention. Muttering this praise three times, you will come out victorious in battles."

glosses.meaning: and the god of all gods

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि |
एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽगस्त्यो जगाम स यथागतम्
verses.iast:
asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṃ tvaṃ vadhiṣyasi |
evamuktvā tato'gastyo jagāma sa yathāgatam
verses.translation: "You will be able to kill Ravana at this very moment, O mighty armed one!" Saying so, the sage, Agastya, thereupon, left as in the same way as he had come.

glosses.meaning: as in the same way as he had come.

verses.devanagari:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोकोऽभवत्तदा |
धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान्
verses.iast:
etacchrutvā mahātejā naṣṭaśoko'bhavattadā |
dhārayāmāsa suprīto rāghavaḥ prayatātmavān
verses.translation: Hearing this, Rama of extra ordinary energy, then became bereft of anguish. Feeling greatly delighted, Rama retained that hymn in his memory with a devoted mind.

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वा तु परं हर्षमवाप्तवान् |
त्रिराचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्
रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धार्थं समुपागमत् |
सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
ādityaṃ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṃ harṣamavāptavān |
trirācamya śucirbhūtvā dhanurādāya vīryavān
rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā yuddhārthaṃ samupāgamat |
sarvayatnena mahatā vadhe tasya dhṛto'bhavat
verses.translation: Sipping the water thrice and getting purified looking intently on the orb of the sun and repeating this prayer, the valiant Rama obtained a great rejoice. Seizing hold of his bow and seeing Ravana, Rama felt delighted in mind and marched forward for the fight. He stood voed to kill Ravana, with an intense and all-sided effort.

glosses.meaning: on the orb of the sun
with an intense and all-sided effort.

verses.devanagari:
अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य रामं |
मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः |
निशिचरपतिसंक्षयं विदित्वा |
सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति
verses.iast:
atha raviravadannirīkṣya rāmaṃ |
muditamanāḥ paramaṃ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ |
niśicarapatisaṅkṣayaṃ viditvā |
suragaṇamadhyagato vacastvareti
verses.translation: Seeing Rama with a delighted mind, and becoming most exhildrated on foreseeing the death of Ravana, the sun-god, standing in the middle of a troop of celestials, exclaimed, "Hasten up."

glosses.meaning: standing as he was in teh middle of a troop of celestials.
